scientific_integrity: The prior scalar period formula and previously established phase portraits are attributed. Uniform log-phase and explicit physical-time marginal laws are the sole new theorem assessed; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed strictly positive coefficients and small conserved product; W1 not total variation; no optimality of O(1/log(1/h)) constant; priority could be affected by unindexed generic heteroclinic scaling literature.
title: Uniform tropical phase and logarithmic-abundance laws near a cubic sphere-flow heteroclinic cycle
